p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, production standards, start-up, investment platforms: official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules always vary: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens up the current official sources, then you can read them in your own language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: World Trade Assistance Centre (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): One Product and One Country, Duties, Taxes, Regulations and Practices in One Page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Chart (ITC): Customs Duties and Production Rules
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): Standards, encryption and health regulations for products set by this country
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access to markets: Trade with and from the European Union, gradually
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs codes and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): Start-up, Tax, International Trade, by Country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): Check that a site is not marked by the administration before trusting money
p.espaces.rg_note: Open a site in its native language: Use your browser's translation, or use "Understand the documentation" for the documentation. For more important results, ask a local expert.
p.espaces.cu_d: Duties, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and transportation.
p.espaces.cu_sub: A guide to buying and selling between countries. 24/24 ONE WORLD does not file customs declarations: an authorized customs trader (shipping) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): Duties and Rules for All Countries
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): Duties, taxes, production regulations, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs Code (HS Code) and Duties Payable upon Entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: Export document (sea), Air ticket (air), CMR (road)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (for businesses importing or exporting to the European Union)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the production: Sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, approval certificate, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the export-finished goods to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on the ship; afterwards, the risks and costs are the responsibility of the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays for transport and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller ships to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: All including import duties must be paid by the seller.
p.espaces.cu_ban: All prohibited or restricted: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. Such lists are rejected and may be reported (ar).
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the correct regulations for your production.

p.espaces.ds_d: Selling without stock: Find a distributor, calculate the real price, be under the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Selling an item in dropshipping means that the manufacturer distributes it directly to your customers. It's easy to get started, but you have to take responsibility for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Select an item that is allowed in your customers' country: no counterfeit items, no unlicensed controlled items.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a distributor (here "seller/dealer" lists or sales sites) and order a sample before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Find out the real price: production, transportation, customs, interest in the customer country, fees to be paid and refund.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the real delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activity: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see business regulations).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect consumers’ rights: clear pricing, including tax, right of withdrawal, guarantee, data protection.
